caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF JACK REVELS TUCKER JORDAN
text: Jack Revels Tucker Jordan, of North Kansas City, Missouri, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of April 24, 2023; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Jack Revels Tucker Jordan is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
